# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published Arcade release. Older 0.x
releases may not receive backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub issue for a vulnerability, leaked credential, or
report containing sensitive data. Use Vercel's private security reporting
process at <https://vercel.com/security> and identify the affected project as
`vercel-labs/arcade`.

Include the affected version or commit, reproduction steps, impact, and any
suggested mitigation. Never include live credentials; revoke or rotate an
exposed credential before sharing a redacted report.

Ordinary bugs and feature requests can use the public issue tracker.
